actions.reason: C0001 has a coherent RNA-defined immune/inflammatory identity with large effect sizes and very small q-values, supported by CNV alterations at VHL/SETD2/PBRM1 loci and chr14q loss. WXS mutation enrichment is weak after FDR but does not actively contradict the identity. Measured technical factors show no significant association after multiple-testing correction. Structural metrics are weak but do not positively support Split or Merge, and the boundary to C0002 is not strongly separated. Retaining C0001 as a discovery-stage candidate is better supported than Drop.

C0002 shows a coherent RNA-defined pattern opposite to C0001 (immune suppression, pancreas beta cell and heme metabolism upregulation) with large effect sizes and very small q-values, and lower CNV signal at key ccRCC loci. WXS mutation enrichment is weak after FDR but not contradictory. Measured technical factors show no significant association after multiple-testing correction. Structural metrics are weak but do not positively support Split or Merge, and the boundary to C0001 is not strongly separated. Retaining C0002 as a discovery-stage candidate is better supported than Drop.
